title: ToolList
description: The answer of GET /api/v1/tools on openvibe.tools (capability tools.tool.read; ADR-027): every tool's descriptor (tools.tool@1), with input and output schemas in the { $ref } form (GET /api/v1/tools/:id has them embedded). Filters: ?family=, ?execution=client|sync|job, ?api=true|false, ?status=, ?q= (name, summary and keywords). Planned placeholders are not tools and are not listed. Cacheable (ETag); updated_at changes when any descriptor does.

count.description: The number of tools in this answer.

families.description: The families of the tools in this answer.
